mechanism: Betamethasone may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of guanfacine through sodium retention and fluid accumulation effects, while guanfacine's alpha-2 agonism may potentiate corticosteroid-induced hyperglycemia and CNS effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; betamethasone may require dose adjustment or alternative corticosteroid selection; assess blood glucose regularly and counsel on sodium restriction.
